buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to

increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added ATC : 1. Earnest Money Deposit: Bidders shall upload EMD particulars or exemption documents in the relevant section of GeM while quoting the bid. Please refer clause (a) of the bid docu ment, clause 4 subclause XIII (m) and clause 2(k) of General Terms and Conditions on GeM h yperlinked with the bid document for further details on Earnest Money Deposit. The EMD sh all be submitted in Sealed Envelope with GeM bid number and date, Firm's complete addres s to Senior Divisional Finance Manager, Opposite Rail Nilayam, Hyderabad Bhavan, Hyderab ad Division, Secunderabad, Telangana - 500003. 2. Special Eligibility criteria : (I) Past Performance Clause : This clause is in supersession of Past performance c riteria in clause (3) of the bid document. Past performance criterion shall be evaluate d as per following condition. (A) The bidder must have satisfactorily executed at least one single purchase order i n Railways / Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Units for "Lapto p/Desktop/All-in-one PC/ Tablet/Professional Live production System of any specification" for a atleast 20% of tender value i.e. Rs 4,79,612 or more, ag ainst single purchase order/GeM contract placed during three preceding completed fi nancial year and current year up to date of bid closing. The onus of submission of req uisite supply performance documents i.e CRAC/ CRN/ Receipt Notes/ Proof of accepta nce of material by consignee along with concerned Purchase order shall be on the bi dder. (B) For Authorized dealers, tender/bid specific authorization from OEM has to be furni shed along with their offer. The bid specific authorization should be in OEM letterhea d containing the GeM Bid No. and Date, Complete address of OEM, undertaking regar ding fulfillment of warranty obligations by OEM within warranty period etc. The bid sp ecific authorization should be signed by authorized signatory of the OEM and should c ontain the Name, Designation, Contact Number and Email of the authorized signatory of OEM. (II) Availability of Service Centre: The OEM/Authorised Service Centre of OEM sha ll be located in the State of Consignee's Location (Preferably Hyderabad ) for post sal e support within 02 working days for warranty replacements, update of software upd ates etc and documentary proof to this effect shall be submitted along with the offer.

(III) The bidder shall submit an OEM Escalation Matrix containing the names, designa tions, mobile numbers and e-mail IDs of at least three levels of officials for technical support and after-sales service. Non-submission of the OEM Escalation Matrix shall re nder the bid liable for rejection. (IV) The bidder shall submit an OEM Warranty Confirmation Certificate on the OEM's letterhead, confirming compliance with the warranty requirements specified in the bi d document. Non-submission of the certificate shall render the bid liable for rejection. (V) Submission of Undertaking for Truthfulness : The tenderers shall submit a c opy of certificate stating that all their statements/ documents submitted along with t he bid are true and factual. Standard format of certificate to be submitted by the bid der is enclosed as Annexure-l. Non submission of above certificate by the bidd er shall result in summary rejection of his/ their bid. It shall be mandatorily inc umbent upon the tenderer to identify, state and submit the supporting documents du ly self-attested / digitally signed by which they/ he is qualifying the Qualifying Criteria mentioned in the Tender Document. (VI) Bidders are required to download the technical specification sheet provided with the tender, duly fill in the Make and Model details, sign and stamp document, and upl oad it along with their bid. Any deviation from the specifications shall render the bid l iable for rejection. Note : Post tender opening no new documents (which are not part of origin al bid offer uploaded by bidder before opening of GeM bid, other than shortfall documents) will be considered for bid evaluation. Bidder's offer is su mmarily to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Eligibility criteria, Bid document, Buyer Added Bid Specific Additional Terms an d Conditions and Corrigendum if any. 3. Special Conditions: I) Warranty Clause: The Live Production System/On Hand Terminal Tablet shall be covered by a comprehensive onsite warranty for a period of 12 (Twelve) months from the da te of successful installation, commissioning and acceptance by the consignee. II) Local content certificate: The bidder is required to upload local content declaration fr om OEM declaring the percentage of local content and complete address of local value addit ion as per PPP-MII policy. III) GST : Please refer to Clause 8 of GeM GTC hyperlinked with the bid document. The buy er shall raise an invoice for S.C. Railway (Telangana) GST NO: 36AAAGM0289C1ZK for Telan gana based consignee and S.C. Railway (AP) GST No: 37AAAGM0289C1ZI for Andhra Prades h based Consignee.

IV) Delivery Period and Extension Of Delivery : Time is the essence of Contract. Please refer to Clause 15 of GeM GTC hyperlinked with bid. Bidder shall adhere to the timeline men tioned in bid / contract for supply of goods. V) Failure of Contract & Recoverable Damages : If the Seller fails to supply goods as p er GeM contract within Delivery period or extended delivery period or at any time repudiate s the contract before the expiry of delivery period, Buyer reserves the right to cancel the Ge M contract for unsupplied portion, record adverse performance of the bidder for taking an a ppropriate administrative action (a) through Incident Management of GeM (b) rejection of of fer on account of bad performance in ensuing bids invited by buyer, (c) forfeit the security d eposit (ePBG) or initiate recoveries outstanding for an amount equivalent to applicable Secu rity Deposit for undelivered portion. (d) In severable contracts, in case of failure by the selle r to meet deliveries for any lot, Railways may cancel the contract for defaulted part by forfei ting SD commensurate with that lot or initiating recoveries for an amount equivalent to Secu rity Deposit /PBG for the undelivered portion. VI) Removal of Rejected Goods: Bidders shall refer Clause 11(iv) of GeM GTC hyperlink e d with bid. It is to mention that if Seller fails to lift the rejected stores within 10 working days of rejection CRAC, then they can lift within a further 15 days after payment of applicable Gr ound rent. Beyond 25 working days ( initial 10 working days rent free period and further 15 days with ground rent), Consignee shall have the right to dispose of such rejected goods at t he risk and cost of the seller. No claim of any form from the seller shall be entertained o n this account by the buyer. Buyer shall take action as per Clause 6 of ATC mentioned in the b id. VII) Payment Terms: 100 percent payment will be made after successful installation and acceptance of goods by consignee. Part Inspection/ part supply/part payment may be allow ed. VIII) The contractor shall submit a Security Deposit equivalent to 5% of the contract value, i n cases where the contract value exceeds ₹25 lakh. The Security Deposit must be submitte d within 15 days from the date of award of contract 04) Mandatory Documents to be uploaded with the offer: a) EMD or EMD exemption document in the relevant section of GeM. b) Past performance documents as specified in Clause 4 of the ATC. c) OEM Bid specific authorization as per Clause 4 of the ATC. d) Availability of the service center proof as per Clause 4 of the ATC. e) Local content certificate as per Clause 5 (IV) of the ATC. . 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
